item.title: Today's Rust Updates — Nov 02
item.description:
47 development commits

✨ NEW — LAST 3 HRS

  • Birds now glide when descending, their flee distance increased to 1000 (letting them travel across the map and be used to track explosions), and crows now circle corpses from higher above.
  • Fixed animal name display for right-to-left languages, ensuring proper naming in-game for RTL language players.
  • Resolved a null reference error that could crash the phone system, improving stability when destroying phones.
